entries.zh: 致幻气体移除
entries.en: Hallucinogen Removal

entries.zh: 尝试移除我们在[Root.GetName]上的致幻气体。
entries.en: Attempt to remove the hallucinogen from [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere.

entries.zh: 小行星防御系统
entries.en: Asteroid Defense System

entries.zh: 我们必须研究如何最好的保护我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民地，使其免受小行星的侵袭。
entries.en: We must investigate how best to protect the colony on [Root.GetName] from the frequent asteroid impacts which plague the planet.

entries.zh: 研究泰坦巨兽
entries.en: Titanic Life Study

entries.zh: 通过研究在[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们有望了解它们，甚至与它们进行交流。
entries.en: By studying the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we can hopefully learn to understand them and possibly even communicate.

entries.zh: 解剖泰坦巨兽
entries.en: Titanic Life Necropsies

entries.zh: 通过捕获在[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们将会研究出如何利用它们！
entries.en: By harvesting the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we should soon work out how best to exploit them!

entries.zh: 监视泰坦巨兽
entries.en: Titanic Life Monitoring

entries.zh: 通过谨慎地监视[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们希望尽可能与它们和平共处。
entries.en: By carefully monitoring the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we hope to be able to coexist peacefully with them.

entries.zh: 报复性基因测序
entries.en: Retaliatory Genome Mapping

entries.zh: 派遣一艘舰船去外星人的母星，我们将在它们身上收集那些我们认为它们从我们身上搜集了的数据。
entries.en: Sending a ship to the alien homeworld, we will be able to gather the same data on them that we suspect them to have on us.

entries.zh: 木管乐器调查
entries.en: Woodwind Instrument Investigation

entries.zh: 我们必须找出那个似乎对我们有放松作用的神秘乐器的原始物质。
entries.en: We must find the source material of the mysterious instrument that appears to have a relaxing effect on us.

entries.zh: [missing_pops_planet.GetName]上的失踪事件
entries.en: Disappearances on [missing_pops_planet.GetName]

entries.zh: [missing_pops_planet.GetName]的执法部门为了顺利地调查最近的一起神秘的人口失踪事件，需要军队的配合来平息骚乱。
entries.en: Local law-enforcement on [missing_pops_planet.GetName] need the support of a military strike force to stifle unrest as they investigate a recent wave of mysterious disappearances.

entries.zh: 寿无限
entries.en: Ageless

entries.zh: 最近一种名叫寿无限的抗衰老霜疯狂地在全帝国境内传播。这种抗衰老霜已经被证实具有刺激细胞再生的功能。如果我们能确定其中起作用的成分，或许能延长其有效时间。
entries.en: The new anti-aging cream Ageless is spreading like a wild-fire throughout the empire, and has shown promise of actually stimulating cell-regeneration. If we could identify the active agent we might be able to use it to produce a more lasting effect.

entries.zh: 追求不老的存在
entries.en: In Pursuit of a Wrinkle-Free Existence

entries.zh: 我们必须找到这种抗衰老霜的来源。
entries.en: We must find the origin of this cream.

entries.zh: 调查[Root.GetName]的磁场之谜
entries.en: Investigate the Magnetic Mystery of [Root.GetName]

entries.zh: 数个奇怪的磁场干扰已经影响了[Root.GetName]上的生活。直到不久之前，磁场干扰的起因仍是个谜，但现在我们已经积累了足够的数据，应该可以揭露真相了。
entries.en: Several strange magnetic disturbances have unsettled life on [Root.GetName]. Until recently their cause was a complete mystery, but with the data gathered from repeated events it should now be possible to uncover the truth behind them.

entries.zh: 调查[Root.GetName]的神秘卫星
entries.en: Investigate the Mysterious Moon of [Root.GetName]

entries.zh: 对[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]进行详细勘察，试图弄清它的来源。
entries.en: Conduct a detailed survey of [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] and attempt to figure out where it came from.

entries.zh: 探测[Root.GetName]上的位面传送门
entries.en: Probe the Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName]

entries.zh: 调查位面传送门通向何方。
entries.en: Investigate where the Dimensional Portal leads to.

entries.zh: 关闭传送门！
entries.en: Close the portal!

entries.zh: 通过科学研究一定可以找到关闭这个传送门的方法！
entries.en: There has to be a way to close this portal, and science will find it!

entries.zh: 关闭传送门！
entries.en: Close the portal!

entries.zh: 这个传送门一定可以用正能量来反制！
entries.en: Such a portal can surely be countered with positive energy!

entries.zh: 关闭传送门！
entries.en: Close the portal!

entries.zh: 这个传送门一定可以用灵能来反制！
entries.en: Such a portal can surely be countered with Psionic energy!

entries.zh: 关闭传送门！
entries.en: Close the portal!

entries.zh: 往里丢足够多的石头，或许可以把它堵住？
entries.en: Perhaps dumping enough rock into the portal will block it up?

entries.zh: 借助科学
entries.en: Use Science

entries.zh: 科学！我们相信科学！在进行了一系列细致的观察和颇具成效的会议讨论，我们打算找到那些蛇类的行为模式，系统性地采纳了一套对付它们的方案。如果我们找得到合适的工具和有效的策略，我们甚至可以找到这种现象的原因！即使他们撕咬我们的殖民者、吸取我们的能源，但我们也必须确保不损坏他们的行为数据。
entries.en: Science! We're using science! After a series of careful observations and productive meetings, we intend to find patterns in the ophidians' behaviors and methodically adopt plans to counter them. If we can find evidence of tool use and adaptive strategy, we may even be able to reason with them! We just need to make sure not to corrupt the data by interfering with their activities, even when they're biting colonists and siphoning power.

entries.zh: 使用武力
entries.en: Use Soldiers

entries.zh: 开战！我们想要开战！我们不关心它们为什么来这里。我们也不明白它们在这里干什么。不过我们很清楚：它们讨厌我们，所以得让它们害怕我们。是时候设置哨卡、派遣巡逻队、用蛇类焚化炉为我们的居民开路。把它们烧个精光！不惜一切代价，我们都要战胜这些蠕动的东西。
entries.en: War! We're going to war! We don't know why they came here. We don't fully know what they do here. But we do know this: they hate us, so they must learn to fear us. It's time to post some sentries, set up some patrols, and work our way through from home to home with ophidian incinerators. Burn them out! No matter what the cost, we've got to stand and deliver against anything that slithers.
